$comment: Deliberately minimal: values.yaml and templates/guards.yaml are the contract. This file exists for the checks a template cannot make, or makes too late. `nats` is the bundled upstream nats chart's values, whose templates run before this chart's guards, so a values file that still sets the old client key `nats.service` (a string; it moved to natsClient.service) would fail inside the upstream chart with an error that names neither key. `global` is handed to every subchart, so its keys are typed here before any template reads them. Schema validation runs before any template.

publicUrl.description: The origin browsers open, e.g. https://elitea.example.com. Fills DEPLOYMENT_URL, OIDC_REDIRECT_URI, the authentication document's public_origin, GATEWAY_SELF_LLM_ORIGINS, worker.runtime.publicBaseUrl, worker.runtimeSession.expectedIdentity and the Ingress host where each is empty (#1460).

trustedProxyCidrs.description: The proxies whose X-Forwarded-For elitea-main believes. Fills main.env.ELITEA_TRUSTED_PROXY_CIDRS and the authentication document's trusted_proxy_cidrs where each is empty.

otelEndpoint.description: An OTLP/HTTP collector outside this chart; every component's default OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT.

create.description: true: the chart renders the internal CA chain and a runtime CA Issuer over runtime.caSecretName, namespaced.

sharedProperties.description: Mode 3 only: read a value that several Secrets carry from one flat property (runtime-ca.crt, runtime-ca.key, command-signing-keyring.json, gateway-identity-secret).

service.description: The bundled NATS server's Service settings (upstream nats chart). The NATS client's service NAME moved to natsClient.service; see docs/UPGRADING.md, 'One chart: NATS bundled'.

kind.description: Issuer or ClusterIssuer. Empty: Issuer with certManager.issuers.create, ClusterIssuer without.
